_readme: This is the knowledge base for the site's chat assistant. Add or edit entries here — each has keywords to match against a visitor's question, and an answer the bot will give. No sensitive personal data belongs here.

capabilities.answer: I can tell you about Zeenan's services, certifications, pricing approach, worldwide availability, and how to book a consultation. I can also take you straight to the appointment form, contact section, projects, or blog. Try asking something like 'what services do you offer' or 'how do I book a call'!

identity.answer: I'm Zeenan's assistant! Haa Meem Ul Karim Zeenan (goes by Zeenan) is a Digital Marketing Expert & Consultant, NSDA Level 3 certified, working with clients across Europe, America, and Asia.

services.answer: Zeenan offers SEO (search engine optimization), content strategy & writing, keyword research, and social media marketing. Want to book a consultation? Just ask me to take you to the appointment form.

seo_service.answer: Yes — SEO is one of Zeenan's core services, covering on-page optimization, technical fixes, and content structure to help a site actually rank for what people search. Want to book a consultation to talk specifics?

content_strategy.answer: Content strategy and writing is one of Zeenan's core services — building content that targets real search intent instead of generic filler. Want to see the Projects section for a sample of the process?

social_media_service.answer: Social media marketing is part of Zeenan's services — strategy and content tailored to the platform your customers actually use. Want to book a consultation to discuss your specific needs?

certifications.answer: Zeenan holds an NSDA (National Skills Development Authority, Bangladesh Government) Level 3 certification in Digital Marketing for Freelancing, plus a Professional Digital Marketing certificate (Grade A+) from Creative IT Institute. Check the Certifications section for the full details.

experience.answer: Zeenan is NSDA Level 3 certified in Digital Marketing and holds a Professional Digital Marketing certificate (Grade A+) from Creative IT Institute, with hands-on project experience across SEO, content, and social media. Check the Certifications and Projects sections for details.

location.answer: Zeenan is based in Bangladesh and works with clients across Europe, America, and Asia — fully remote, so location isn't a barrier.

contact.answer: You can reach Zeenan by email at haameemulkarim.zeenan.dm@gmail.com, on WhatsApp, or through the appointment form on this site. Want me to take you to the contact section?

appointment.answer: You can apply for an appointment right on this site — want me to scroll you there? Just fill in your name, WhatsApp number, email, purpose, and goal, and Zeenan will get back to you within 1-2 business days.

pricing.answer: Pricing depends on the scope of work — every project is a little different. The best way to get an accurate quote is to book a quick consultation through the appointment form so Zeenan can understand what you need.

seo_general.answer: SEO (Search Engine Optimization) is the practice of improving a website so it ranks higher in search results and gets found by the right people. There's a whole blog on this site with practical SEO guides if you want to dig deeper — want me to take you there?

keyword_research.answer: Keyword research means figuring out exactly what your potential customers type into Google, so your content targets real search demand instead of guesswork. Check the Projects section for a sample of what this looks like in practice.

blog.answer: There's a full blog on this site covering SEO, keyword research, and digital marketing tips — great if you want to learn the fundamentals yourself. Want me to take you there?

worldwide.answer: Yes — Zeenan works with clients across Europe, America, and Asia, not just Bangladesh. All work is done remotely, so distance isn't an issue.

response_time.answer: Zeenan typically responds within 1-2 business days after you submit the appointment form.

greeting.answer: Hey there! 👋 I'm Zeenan's assistant. Ask me about services, pricing, certifications, or say 'book' if you'd like to set up a consultation.

thanks.answer: You're very welcome! Don't hesitate to ask if anything else comes up. 🙌

portfolio_projects.answer: Client work stays confidential — Zeenan respects that fully. But there's a sample keyword research breakdown in the Projects section that shows the kind of process used before any content gets written. Want me to take you there?

small_business.answer: Zeenan works with businesses of all sizes, including small and local shops — practical, budget-aware marketing rather than one-size-fits-all corporate strategy. Want to book a consultation to talk through your specific situation?

ecommerce.answer: Yes, ecommerce SEO and content strategy fall within Zeenan's services — helping online stores get found by people actually ready to buy. Want to book a consultation?

why_choose.answer: Zeenan focuses on practical, data-backed strategy — real keyword research and SEO fundamentals — over generic advice or vanity metrics. NSDA Level 3 certified with a track record across international clients.

languages.answer: Zeenan communicates fluently in both English and Bangla, which is especially useful for businesses targeting Bangladeshi or South Asian audiences alongside international ones.

process.answer: It starts with a quick consultation — book through the appointment form, and Zeenan will follow up to understand your goals before proposing a plan. Want me to take you to the form?
